# EzHomes

EzHomes is a modern homes plugin for 1.21.x

| Command | Permissions | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/homes` | `ezhomes.home.1` | Access to home 1 |
| `/homes` | `ezhomes.home.2` | Access to home 2 |
| `/homes` | `ezhomes.home.3` | Access to home 3 |
| `/homes` | `ezhomes.home.4` | Access to home 4 |
| `/homes` | `ezhomes.home.5` | Access to home 5 |
| `/homes` | `ezhomes.home.6` | Access to home 6 |
| `/homes` | `ezhomes.home.7` | Access to home 7 |

(every permission is on by default)
